items.html: We find that the Yesod, although its measure there is small, being only a third of the Tifferet as above, nevertheless, because it clothed and was included in the entire Tifferet of Arich in its entirety, as mentioned, its illumination grew, and it made in ZA the Tifferet and Yesod within him. And in the lower third of the Tifferet of Arich there were very doubled illuminations, more than in the NH. For the NH, each one of them was included, this one in Hesed and that one in Gevura, and from the power of that inclusion, each of them became two small measures in ZA, as mentioned. But the third of the Tifferet was included from itself in the two upper thirds — here is one great inclusion, for it is from itself, unlike the NHY, which take their illumination from others; but this one is from itself and takes an illumination greater than theirs by far. And in addition to this, his own Yesod was included in him.
